name: BE GRAND Bohol International Marathon 2027
short_description: BE GRAND Bohol International Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 22 August 2027 in Panglao, Bohol, over 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: BE GRAND Bohol International Marathon 2027 is the next edition of the Bohol International Marathon in Panglao, Bohol, with registration through MEGATechPH. Categories are 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km. The venue and start times for 2027 have not been published on the registration page.

faqs.question: How much is the full marathon at the BE GRAND Bohol International Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: The 42 km costs PHP 3,499 at the regular rate, after an early-bird rate of PHP 2,999 that ran until 23 September 2026. The 21 km is PHP 3,199 regular, and the 10 km and 5 km are PHP 2,199 each.

faqs.question: What is included in the Bohol International Marathon 2027 race kit?
faqs.answer: The 42 km, 21 km and 10 km include an event shirt, finisher shirt, finisher medal (5-inch for the 42 km), race bib with timing chip and a post-race snack. The 5 km has no medal listed and includes a post-race meal.
